chat.title: ChooseTounsi Assistant
chat.faqWelcome:
Hello! 👋 Welcome to ChooseTounsi Support.

How can I assist you today? Please choose a topic below, or pick a specific question.
chat.anythingElse: Is there anything else I can help you with?

where-order.label: Where is my order?
where-order.response: You can follow your order from your orders page — each order shows its current status (Pending, Processing, Out for delivery, Delivered…). You can also ask the AI assistant "Track my order" while logged in.

track-order.label: I want to track my order
track-order.response: Head to your orders page — each order shows its current status and delivery progress. D17 orders stay Pending until our team confirms your transfer.

delayed-order.label: My order is delayed
delayed-order.response: We're sorry! Please check your order status first. Complaints can only be filed once an order is delivered, so if your order is taking too long, contact our support team with your order number.

wrong-person.label: Delivered to the wrong person
wrong-person.response: That shouldn't happen! If your order shows as Delivered, file a complaint within 48 hours of delivery with a description of the situation. Otherwise, contact our support team with your order number.

missing-damaged.label: Order missing / damaged / incorrect
missing-damaged.response: We sincerely apologise. File a complaint within 48 hours of delivery: choose the reason (wrong product, size, color, damaged…), describe the problem, attach a photo if possible, and ask for an exchange or a return & refund.

return-order.label: How can I return my order?
return-order.response: You can request a return within 48 hours of delivery, one complaint per order. Go to Complaints → New complaint, select the order and items, describe the problem and choose "Return & refund" or "Exchange".

return-status.label: Check the status of my return
return-status.response: Return status is visible under My complaints: Pending → Reviewing → Approved or Rejected. If the seller rejects it, our admin team reviews it.

refund.label: When will I receive my refund?
refund.response: Once your return is approved, a courier picks up the item and your refund is processed. You can follow each step under My complaints.

payment-issue.label: Problem with my payment
payment-issue.response: At checkout you can pay by cash on delivery, wallet, D17 or bank card (Visa / Mastercard via Stripe). If you encountered an unexpected charge, please contact us directly.

update-account.label: Update my account information
update-account.response: You can see your account details on your profile page and manage your delivery addresses in Account → Addresses. Forgot your password? Use "Forgot password?" on the login page.

contact.label: Contact support
contact.response: Our support team is available Saturday–Thursday, 9 AM – 6 PM (Tunisia time). You can reach us at support@choosetounsi.tn.

other.label: Something else
other.response: No problem! Please email us at support@choosetounsi.tn and describe your issue in detail. We typically respond within 4 business hours.
